profile.scope: Each trace is a 12-forward sample including prefill. Kernel-duration sums are not end-to-end throughput. Projection attribution is inferred from verified serial layer order, requiring exactly 114 shrink kernels per decode span.

projection_A.scope: Projection attribution inferred from verified serial SGLang layer forward order, asserting exactly 114 A kernels per GPU model-forward span; not kernel-emitted projection labels.

validation.numerical_gate: Same token IDs in 20 cases; max logprob difference <= 0.05; request reset and mixed batch repeatability

rejected_launch.decision: Rejected and reverted. Across C1/8/32 the candidate achieved 0.9903/0.9870/0.9838 of the previous Fleet throughput on the same card.

limits: Short single-node matched pilot, fixed order native/control/candidate; no randomized order or confidence interval across independent runs.
Synthetic nonzero adapters; no trained-adapter quality result.
Base-only was not remeasured in the launch trial.
Profile kernel sums and cache-warm operator timings are not service speedups.

operator_study.scope: Cache-warm operator study, not serving throughput
operator_study.BA_B_excluded: BA B comparison is excluded: synthetic slots used different random factors for the same retained checkpoint key, causing shared-region aliasing. BA B policy is unchanged and no candidate decision uses that comparison. A measurements and other B projections use distinct checkpoint keys.
limitations: 42 isolated cache-warm cases; graph has 16 calls, 10 replays, three measurements.
A differences are not a substitute for full-model validation; BA B measurements excluded for invalid checkpoint aliasing.
Tested Triton tile variants and launch bounds did not improve on native A materially.

profiles.shape: HIP A for down/out/o through C32 and gate/qkv through C8; native prefill and GDN input A.
profiles.long: HIP A only for down/out/o through C32; native prefill.
profiles.b_only: Native A throughout; native B for down/out/o/qkv at graph batch >=32 and at most four catalogued adapters. Other supported decode B uses RowExpand.

shaped_dispatch_trial.decision: Neither HIP-A variant passed the model gate. B-only passed but is not adopted independently: its C32 gain over control is close to the drift also visible at C1, whose dispatch is unchanged. No new accepted service speedup.
limitations: Single device, fixed arm order, three timed repetitions; no confidence interval.
No base-only arm in this follow-up.
Both native and Fleet use the same bridge; adapters are synthetic.

mlp_ablation.stop_reason: Both predefined profiles failed the model gate; the driver stopped before candidate timing and before its conservative-control arm.

profiles.mlp: HIP A only down_proj at graph batch <=32 and gate_up_proj <=8; native prefill and all attention/GDN A.
profiles.down: HIP A only down_proj at graph batch <=32; all other A and prefill native.

mlp_ablation.B_dispatch: Same as b_only in shaped_dispatch_trial; unchanged from conservative B at batch 1, where the worst differences occur.

protocol.adapters: same four synthetic factors as baseline

mlp_ablation.decision: No candidate adopted or timed. The failure is reproduced with only down-projection A changed at the offending single-request cases; keeping GDN A native is insufficient.
limits: Native/Fleet model comparison is between the same format bridge, not Transformers/PEFT.
Short numerical pilot, no task-quality evaluation.
Do not relabel the FAILED allocation or rejected numerical gate as passed.

paper_reconciliation.scope: CPU reconciliation of existing paper records and recorded full-model traces. No new GPU run.

native_source_verification.method: Read-only sha256sum on the installed LUMI source, compared to the paper's expected-runtime.json on 2026-11-04.

batch32_work_items.derivation: Prepared profile request has 32 rows round-robin over four adapters; SGLang groups them into four 8-row chunks at max_len=16. Fleet's hybrid policy uses 256 output threads and 880 persistent blocks.
batch32_work_items.limitation: Analytical work counts from request routing and code, not measured occupancy or bandwidth counters.
batch32_work_items.next_control: For narrow output, test 128 output threads and 2/4-row segments. A cap of 8 alone cannot change an already 8-row segment. Compare native B by shape and retain the same per-token reduction order.

limitations: Paper ratios are equal-weight geometric means over synthetic operator cases; service traces are sums weighted by actual layer counts.
Projection labels are inferred from inspected serial model order after verifying 114 alternating A/B pairs per decode step; not explicit labels in the GPU trace.
Profiled kernel durations include profiler overhead and are not end-to-end serving latency.
Warm operator study, flushed paper ablations and full-model traces have different cache regimes; no cross-study percentage is a controlled causal effect.
